report.explanation: Current telemetry is largely healthy: order checkout trace OK (66ms), gateway/order/payment error_rate 0.0014 with p95 70ms, and INFO 200 logs. Only inventory shows an anomaly (error_rate 0.1, configuration_rejections 14), but no evidence links it to checkout errors or latency. The alert is not substantiated by current observations, so no bounded root-cause candidate can be established; hand off for further evidence.
